linux_setup_title: Asebded n wallalen n Linux & SP Flash
linux_setup_welcome: Asebded n wallal n SP Flash i Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Asekcem d usemres n umuṭu n usmel s tɣawla akken ad tzemreḍ ad d-terreḍ yerna ad tesnefliḍ amyurar-ik war lǧehd.
linux_card_engine_desc: MediaTek allal n usfugel anaṣli s tmeẓla n temkarḍit tamaḍlant yettwasbedden.
linux_card_usb_desc: Yefka ttesriḥ n uḍris akken ad yettmeslay d umyurar deg tegnit n Bootloader.

settings_checker_desc_installer: Yessewjad aselkim-ik akken ad yeqqen s umyurar-ik i usnefli n useɣzan.
settings_checker_group_advanced: Asekcem n wallalen n SP Flash d Aselkim
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Yettwali asebded n Linux igerrzen i SP Flash Tool, anekcum USB, izerfan n tmezgunt, d yiferdisen n unagraw.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Yessewjad aselkim-ik akken ad yeqqen s umyurar-ik yerna ad yesbedd isemtar n useɣzan s tɣawla.
settings_checker_desc: Yessewjad aselkim-ik akken ad yeqqen s umyurar-ik yerna ad yesbedd isemtar n useɣzan s tɣawla.
linux_prep_starting: Aheggi n wallal n SP Flash...
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Aselkim-ik yewjed akken ad yeqqen ɣer umyurar-ik.
linux_prep_connected_friendly: Yufa-d amyurar, yesnefli anekcum n tuqqna...
linux_prep_not_connected_friendly: Tzemreḍ ad tcuddeḍ amyurar-ik mi ara t-steqsiḍ.
linux_prep_blocked: Aselkim-a ur yezmir ara ad yeddu Allal n SP Flash.
linux_prep_fix_body: Awal uffir-ik yettwaḥwaǧ yiwet n tikkelt akken ad tesbeddeḍ aselkim-agi i usfeḍ : ilugan n USB i wallalen n MediaTek d unekcum n usmel n tmezgunt.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Akken ad tesbeddeḍ aselkim-a i SP Flash Tool, ad teḥwaǧeḍ awal uffir-ik deg tɣawsa i d-iteddun akken ad tesbeddeḍ ilugan n USB yerna ad ternuḍ amiḍan-ik i trebbaɛ n yiseqdacen n tmezgunt i ilaqen. Ma tugiḍ, ad yettwaqqen useqdec.
linux_prep_needs_access: Ur yettunefk ara unekcum, flashing yeḥwaǧ-it.
linux_prep_fixed: Asekcem yettunefk, Allal n SP Flash yettwahegga.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Asebded yekfa yerna amiḍan-ik yerna-d i trebbaɛ n yiseqdacen i ilaqen i SP Flash Tool. Ttxil sbedd aselkim-ik akken ad ttwaḍemnen yizerfan imaynuten, syen ldi ahil tikkelt nniḍen. Kned ɣef tfelwit n tfelwit akken ad tɣelqeḍ ahil tura.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Yekfa, ɣleq asnas akken ad t-id-terreḍ d aselkim
settings_driver_desc: Uqbel ad tesqedceḍ ahil i tikkelt tamezwarut, yessefk ad tesbeddeḍ aselkim USB n MediaTek, syen ad t-id-terreḍ d aselkim-ik.
system_checker_autofix_btn: Izerfan n useggem s wudem awurman d unagraw n usebded
system_checker_launch_gui_btn: Sker GUI n wallal n SP Flash
home_desc: Af-d aselkim ameẓyan deg unrar neɣ fren yiwen n uferdis adigan, syen sfeḍ-it deg tmeẓdit-ik.
sel_source_desc: Ssiweḍ-d aselkim amecṭuḥ deg lantirnat, naɣ ssekcem-d aferdis adigan.
settings_advanced_desc: Yettbeggin-d tarrayt n usras, aḥric n usras d yifilṭren n uslelli.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install_desc: App-nni ad yeqqim yid-k s usfeḍ, s tuqqna, d usbedd.
settings_sp_gui_install: Sbedd deg GUI n wallal n SP Flash
settings_sp_gui_desc: Yeqqen Updater yerna yeldi SP Flash Tool GUI s ufaylu n usferreq n useɣzan ameẓyan yettwafernen d tugniwin n tferkit yettwasbedden uqbel.
settings_terminal_desc: Yettkemmil asersi-inek n useɣzan deg Terminal akken ad twaliḍ isalan itwilanen ɣef tmuɣli.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Yettkemmil asersi n useɣzan-ik deg Command Prompt akken ad twaliḍ isalan itwilanen ɣef tmuɣli.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Umaḍgir. Kra n yiswan n MediaTek ugin ad tt-id-sfeḍḍen alamma yettunefk i SP Flash Tool afaylu n usnefli (.auth); rnu-d tin-ik dagi ma yella lḥerǧ-nni yeḥwaǧ yiwen.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Ur yettwaf ara ufaylu n scatter deg tferkit-a, ihi ur yezmir ara ad yettwabnu umyager n tmeẓdit.
terminal_install_no_tool: Ur yelli ara lebni n SP Flash Tool neɣ tanqiḍt n ukeccum n MTKClient i tmeẓla-a.
terminal_install_failed: Ur yezmir ara ad yeldi tasekkirt n usmel. Amḍan n usbedd yettwaru s {path}.
status_terminal_install: Sbedd amḍan yeldin deg tfelwit n tmeẓdit-ik ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} ad yeldi tura tazla {method}.

• Ma yella ur ixeddem ara yakan, sfeḍ {device}-ik.
• Ma yella yeqqen ɣer USB, sfeḍ-it uqbel.
{hint}
• Qqen ahil-ik ɣer uselkim-ik mi ara yeldi usmel {terminal_name}.

Kned ɣef OK akken ad t-tessufɣeḍ yerna ad teffɣeḍ seg Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Tiswiɛt: Ma yella ur yettwaqqen ara usmel s wudem awurman, s tɣawla tḍeggreḍ aqerruy n usnefli yellan deg tɣerɣert n tmeẓẓuɣt s tmeẓẓuɣt n lkaɣeḍ deg wakud aydeg ara tcuddeḍ aẓeḍḍa n USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Tiswiɛt: Ssers aselkim-ik deg tegnit n usnulfu n usmel (yemgarad s lemtel: amedya, kkset aṭaṭar u ḥrez-it s lxiḍ USB icudden, neɣ sfeḍ s tbatrit deg-s, neɣ ḥebbes Volume Down/Up mi ara tcuddeḍ USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Sbedd s GUI n wallal n SP Flash
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI ad yeldi tura s usmel-ik n tmeẓdit yettwasbedden uqbel.

• Deg SP Flash Tool, fren "Asmel" seg tfelwit n tfelwit.
• Klik ɣef tfelwit "Asmel".
• Ḥeqqer belli {device}-ik yettwaxdem yerna yettwaqleɛ.
{hint}
• Qqen aselkim USB ɣer uselkim-ik deffir ma tḍeggreḍ Download.

Kned ɣef OK akken ad tesbeddeḍ Allal n SP Flash yerna ad teffɣeḍ seg Useɣẓan.
settings_install_themes_desc: Mi ara yettwasbedd, isentalen n Rockbox ttwaqedcen s wudem awurman s Y1 d Y2 deffir n usbedd n Rockbox s rrbeḥ.
themes_placement_failed_note: Ur nezmir ara ad nessers aferdis n yisental deg umyurar-ik. Tzemreḍ ad tɛerḍeḍ tikkelt nniḍen seg Isefka.
settings_rockbox_desc: Yettwaseqdec mi ara t-id-tessufɣeḍ s usmel.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Sken-d tiẓrigin n useɣzan anaṣli iqburen n 3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Iḍrisen n useɣzan aẓuran iqburen n 3.0.7 ur ttqadaren ara iferdisen n Y1 yettwasnuzun s Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Asekcem n lebni aqbur ɣef yiferdisen-a ad ten-yeḥbes ad bdun alamma yettwasbedd-d usmel amaynut.

Tḥeqqeḍ belli tebɣiḍ ad d-tessekneḍ tiẓrigin n Uselkim Aẓuran iqburen n 3.0.7?
settings_filter_nightly: Sken-d Tiẓrigin n Dev n Yiḍ
settings_240p_tip: Yettbeggin-d lebni s zip n ROM-is d aferdis n 240p (rom..._240p.zip). 240p lebni ur yettwaqbal ara s yiferdisen Y1 deg Innioasis OS ddaw n 3.0.7, ihi Ssekn lebni n Rockbox aqbur yettwasqedcen yid-s.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Iḍrisen n Rockbox-Y1 uqbel 0.5 ur ttqadaren ara iferdisen n Y1 yettwazenzen deffir Meɣres 2026 s Innioasis OS 3.0.7 i d-yettwasbedden uqbel.

sel_back_to_online: ← Tuɣalin ɣer useɣzan n unagraw n lantirnat
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Ttxil fren .zip, .rar archive, neɣ afaylu n usmel (*scatter*.txt) daxel n uḍris n usmel akken ad tesbeddeḍ aselkim n usmel i tefrenḍ deg {target}-ik.
sel_offline: Imukan n usmel ur llin ara tura. Seqdec afaylu adigan, neɣ senqed tuqqna-inek.
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_title: Aṭas n iferdisen n useɣzan ameẓyan ttwafehmen
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Aṭas n tferkiwin n usmel neɣ ifuyla n tferkit i d-yettwafkan deg uḍris/archive-a. Ttxil fren aḍris neɣ tasekkirt yesɛan kan yiwen n uferdis n useɣzan ameẓyan deg yiwet n tikkelt.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Asekles-a yesɛa ugar n yiwen n ufaylu n usferreq, ihi Updater ur yezmir ara ad d-yini anwa asenfar i ilaqen i umyurar-ik. Amsnulfu n {software} ad yessefk ad yesnefli tiẓrigin-nsen n usmel akken ad d-yesmekti kan yiwen n ufaylu n usferreq.
sp_search_restart: Ulac allal ar tura, yettnadi tikkelt nniḍen (aɛraḍ {count}). Ḥrez amyurar-nni s tmeẓdit yerna qqen-t mi ara t-id-ssutren.
sp_auth_missing_file: Afaylu n usnefli ur yettwaf ara ({path}); yettfeggiḍ mebla ma yella.
sp_config_missing_platform: Afaylu n scatter ur d-yesban ara taɣerɣert-is, ihi ur yezmir ara ad yettwabnu usmel n tmeẓdit i ufaylu n usnefli; yettfeggiḍ mebla ma yella.
sp_config_missing_storage: Afaylu n usferreq ur d-yesban ara ṣṣenf n uḥezzeb (EMMC/NAND/UFS), ihi ur yezmir ara ad yettwabnu usmel n tmeẓdit i ufaylu n usnefli; yettfeggiḍ mebla ma yella.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Ur yettunefk ara ufaylu n usnefli; yettfeggiḍ mebla yiwen.
sp_config_write_failed: Ur yezmir ara ad yaru afaylu n usmel n tmeẓdit; t-id-yesfeḍ war afaylu n usnefli.
settings_notifications_desc: Ssekn-d isalan n unagraw i tɣawsiwin n usmel d usnefli ddaw-a. Off yettḥadar kullec yellan daxel n tesgilt.
settings_notifications_background_btn: Ssekcem iberdan mi ara yettwaqqen useɣzan
settings_add_device_type_hint: Type d asenqed n tɣawsiwin n umyurar. Imyurar n yiwen n lemtel zemren ad ttwabnun deg ugar n yiwet n tmuɣli — amedya n ṣṣenf A d ṣṣenf B — yerna yettwaxdem useɣzan i yiwen seg-sen. Segzi-d sticker yellan deg tlemmast n umyurar; ma yella ur d-yefki ara isem n ṣṣenf, ǧǧ afran amezwaru.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Ur llint ara tfelwiyin i useɣzan-a tura.
settings_notifications_unavailable: Iberdan n unagraw ur llin ara deg uselkim-a.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Ḥrez ahil deg tfelwit n tmenḍawt deffir ma tɣelqeḍ tasekkirt, akken mazal ad d-tafeḍ isalan n usnefli n uhil d umyurar. Off: aɣellet n tfelwit yessufeɣ-d app.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Ḥrez ahil deg tfelwit n unagraw deffir ma tettwagdel tfelwit, akken mazal ad tesɛuḍ isalan n usnefli n uhil d umyurar. Off: aɣellet n tfelwit yessufeɣ-d app.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Effer akatalug n tmetti n usmel yerna sbedd aselkim seg yifuyla idiganen kan.
sel_themepack_prompt_title: Sbedd Taqbuct n Usentel n Rockbox 360p?
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Tesfeḍ-d lebni n Rockbox n 360p. Tebɣiḍ ad tesbeddeḍ 360p Theme Pack deg tmeẓdit-a tura?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Acuddu n Amyurar deg Udem n Uḥezzeb USB
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Ttxil-k, sfeḍ USB, sbedd tazmert yerna sbedd-d Rockbox yiwet n tikkelt (akka ad yebdu aḍris-is n unagraw .rockbox n daxel), syen rẓem USB yerna fren 'Aswir n Uḥezzeb n USB'.

Mi ara tcuddeḍ, efk-d Kemmel akken ad tferneḍ yal aḍris deg umyurar-ik.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Fren yal aḍris deg uḥezzeb n umyurar-ik icudden
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack yettwasbedd s rrbeḥ deg tmeẓdit-ik!
sel_themepack_failed: Asras n Theme Pack ur yezmir ara: {err}

sel_only_local: Fren aferdis n usmel .zip neɣ .rar adigan, neɣ afaylu .txt n uḍris / scatter, i usras n tfelwit, ulac internet i ilaqen. Ixeddem s yal amseḍru n usliḍ Innioasis d Timmkoo.
sel_only_local_generic: Fren yiwen n uferdis n usmel adigan (.zip, .rar) neɣ aḍris yesɛan afaylu n usferreq i usras n tmeẓdit, ixeddem s yifarisen n MediaTek n tmeẓdit.
sel_offline_install: Sbedd aselkim ameẓyan seg ufaylu .zip neɣ .rar deg yal aselkim n usliḍ Innioasis neɣ Timmkoo.
sel_offline_install_generic: Sbedd aselkim ameẓyan seg uḍris n .zip/.rar neɣ seg uḍris n uselkim ameẓyan deg yigensaten n MediaTek n tmeẓdit.
conn_offline: Ur telliḍ ara deg laynut. Ibeddilen seg Uferdis n Uselkim n Temnaḍt ur llin ara.
conn_archive_unavailable: Katalug n useɣzan ameẓyan ur yettwaweḍ ara s tɣawla. Mazal tzemreḍ ad tesbeddeḍ seg tmeẓdit neɣ seg yifuyla idiganen.
single_instance_body: Aḍris nniḍen yeldi, neɣ mazal-it yettkemmil deg tfelwit. Sin n yiḍrisen ad mzazzalen ɣef tuqqna n USB n umyurar, ihi winna ur yebdi ara.

single_instance_force_failed: Ur yezmir ara ad yekfu lqeḍyan yettwaxedmen. Ḥbes-it s timmad-ik, syen bdu-d asenqed tikkelt nniḍen.
single_instance_busy_body: Aḍris yettwaxedmen d asersi n useɣzan neɣ d ameslay d umyurar, ihi ma tkemleḍ-t tura ad t-teqqneḍ aya. Asenfar-a ad yeqqel; sseqdec tasekkirt yellan neɣ tasekkirt-is n tfelwit n tmenḍawt mi ara yekfu usebded.
notices_banner_tooltip: Kned iwakken ad twaliḍ akk iberdan
notices_summary_body: Ldi Tiɣriwin deg tesgilt akken ad tent-teɣreḍ.

toast_battery_charged_device: Send ad tesqedceḍ aya deg wallal-ik, ččarr abatri ma ulac yiwet n tsaɛet

translate_unavailable_notice_body: Imeẓla n tsuqilt deg unrar ur ttwawḍen ara tura neɣ llan deg usgunfu. Ad d-ttwaseknent tmuɣliwin n uslelli aẓuran deg umḍiq-nsent.

dialog_pre_install_header: Ttxil ḍemneḍ belli {model}-inek yettwaxdem yerna ur yettwaqqen ara s USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Ssexsi s lekmal-is aselkim-ik uqbel ad tebduḍ.
• Ma yella aselkim-nni yefres neɣ ur yettqadar ara, sseqdec aferdis neɣ aferdis n lkaɣeḍ deg tɣerɣert n usnefli akken ad tḥettmeḍ tazmert ad texsi deg tegnit n usnefli.
• Ḥrez aẓeḍḍa n USB imir-a.
• Kned Continue, syen qqen aselkim-ik s USB mi ara k-id-ssutren.

flash_hint_wall_charger: • Yettwaɛreḍ ad t-id-teqqneḍ s tmeẓdit n lḥiḍ 30 n tedqiqin arma d yiwet n tsaɛet uqbel ad tɛerḍeḍ ad t-teqqneḍ.

err_keep_data_failed: Ur yezmir ara ad yeḥrez isefka-inek d ttawilat-inek: aḍris n useɣzan ur yettwaru ara. Ulac d acu i yettwasbedden.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Yeṭṭef isefka-inek d ttawilat-inek deg umyurar. Ayen nniḍen n usmel yettwasbedd am yal tikkelt.
flash_keep_data_warning: Ma tkemleḍ mebla aya, isefka-inek d ttawilat-inek ad ttwasemlen deg uḥezzeb n daxel n umyurar.

support_story_1_headline: Mi ara tkemlen yimseftiyen, tettnerni tmetti.
support_story_1_lead: Aḥareb ɣef wallal-ik seg tmeẓdiyin n tmeẓdiyin tisusmiwin d tmuɣliwin yettwaqerḍen.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis tessuffuɣ-d s lqedd iferdisen imaynuten i yimariren am Y1 (s yiswi n tmuɣliwin n tfelwit yeffren am 6.0, 7.0, d 8.0) i yettqerriben s tsusmi i wallalen iqburen. Ayen ixussen, adeg-nsen n Internet yettak-d zero n tmuɣliwin d zero n usmel n tmeẓdiyin (firmwares) ixeddmen zik akken ad d-sfaydin seg yiwen n lḥal n tmeẓdiyin. Updater d usenfar n Community Firmware ttnadin iḥricen: nessemras yal ROM n tmeẓdit n tmeẓdit, nessekcam s wudem awurman asenqed n tmeẓdit-ik, yerna nettaǧǧa amyurar-ik ad yettwaxdem s laman.
support_story_1_item_1: Asellek n Yimurar Iqersen: Iḍrisen n tɣellist ttḍemmiren dakken isemras imaynuten ur ttbeddilen ara aselkim aqbur.
support_story_1_item_2: ROMs n Stock Archived: Asemres n tmeẓdiyin n luzin n Innioasis yettwasfeḍ.
support_story_1_item_3: Taɣerɣert n tmeẓdit taɣelnawt: Allalen n tmeẓdit ikemlen i macOS, Linux, d Windows am wakken.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Asekcem n tfelwit s wudem awurman akken ad d-tafeḍ dima aferdis iwatan.
support_story_2_headline: Ulac iḍebsiyen n Google i iɛerḍen. Ulac axeddim n uxemmem. Aselkim ameẓyan ixeddem kan.
support_story_2_lead: Infrastructure n tmetti s tɣawla, yettwasqedcen i tzemreḍ ad t-tḍemneḍ s tidet.
support_story_2_body: Ad tḍefren aselkim unṣib n Innioasis s umata anamek-is d asekcem n yisental n usmel n Google Drive iɛeddan, tiferkiwin n useyyer n Baidu yemmuten, d yifuyla zip n lbaḍna war allalen n tmeẓẓuɣt. Nebna aẓeḍḍa n usmel yettwasnen, ilelli s tɣellist SHA-256 yettwasqedcen, isalan n usnefli, d usmel yettwasneflen s tɣawla. Tiwsiwin-ik srid ttḥerrifen-d iḍebsiyen d usmel i d-yettaǧǧan aya ad yili 24 n tsaɛtin deg wass, 365 n wussan deg useggas.
support_story_2_item_1: CDN usrid s tɣawla tameqqrant: Asekcem s tɣawla, usrid war tilisa n usekcem neɣ assaɣen yemmuten.
support_story_2_item_2: Ssnefli Ibeddilen: Ttwaɛeqleḍ deg lawan ideg ara d-ffɣen yisuḍaf imaynuten n tmetti neɣ ad d-ɣlin yisuḍaf.
support_story_2_item_3: Installs s tɣawla s tɣawla: Iḍrisen n tmuɣli ibanen ad k-id-ssiwḍen deg yal aḍfar n tmeẓdit.
support_story_2_item_4: Tametti n tutlayin yemgaraden: Tettwassen s lekmal-is s teglizit, tacinwat, talmanit, taspenyulit, tafransist & tajapunit.
support_story_3_headline: Asekcem n tzemmar n umyurar-ik n Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Aggay n Rockbox, inagrawen n uxeddim ifesden s tɣawla, d tlelli n yimesliyen.
support_story_3_body: Aselkim n luzin n usmel yettḥezzib kan ɣef wayen izemren ad t-yexdem usmel-ik Y1 neɣ Y2. Tametti-nneɣ tessekcem-d Rockbox, inagrawen n uxeddim n tmeẓdit ifesden, aẓawan n tmeẓdit n usliḍ, d yisental n tmeẓdit ɣer tudert. Nesɣa imgerraden n tɣawsiwin n tfekka s tɣawla akken ad njerred, ad nbeddel ajenyuṛ, yerna ad nessekcem yal asras. Tadukli n Updater tettḥadar srid tiferkiwin-a n ukayad yerna tessemɣaray asnerni n useɣzan ameẓyan s tɣawla.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox n yiwen n uḍris: Aẓawan n Audiophile d yisental n usmel yettwasbedden deg tesdidin.
support_story_3_item_2: Aselkim n tmetti: Asnerni n tbatrit, UI zeddigen, d tallelt n uḍris n usliḍ atrar.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Nettjerriḍ ɣef yifarisen n tfekka n tidet uqbel ad d-nessuffeɣ kra n lebni.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% d ilelli, d aselkim amezwaru n tɣellist war ma yella-d usmel neɣ aḍfar.
support_story_4_headline: Ɛiwen-aɣ ad nexdem ayen ur xeddmen ara Innioasis.
support_story_4_lead: Aḥareb n useɣzan amecṭuḥ s tezmert n tmetti yettaṭṭafen allalen-ik seg yimukan n tmes.
support_story_4_body: Mi ara tkemmel tkebbanit n tɣawsiwin n tɣawsiwin s tɣawsiwin-nsen ay d-iteddun, ttwaɛezlen yimukan iqburen. Innioasis ur yettak ara aɛiwen n Linux, ur yettak ara iḍrisen n ubeddel ifazen, yerna ur yettak ara abrid s wacu ara d-terreḍ mi ara yeɣli usras. Updater yella acku iseqdacen n tḥemla ur yessefk ara ad sneqsen aẓawan yelhan s lekmal-is. 100% n ttawilat n tmetti ttṛuḥun srid ɣer uḥraz n wallal-a yeldin i yal yiwen.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Asenqes yettwasnen yettkemmil ula ma ugin wallalen ad bdun.
support_story_4_item_2: Tallalt n Linux n Tmezgunt Tamezwarut: Taɛiwen s lekmal-is MediaTek yettfeggiḍen deg tferkiwin n Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Tiɣriwin n uslelli s tɣawla akken ad tessneḍ akken iwata d acu i yettbeddilen.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% s tedrimt n tmetti: Yal lqahwa tettaǧǧa archive yeldi yerna d ilelli i yal yiwen.

2. Mi ara d-yeffeɣ Rockbox, sqedceḍ aẓeḍḍa n USB deg uselkim-ik.

themepack_step2_desc: Imi inagrawen n uselkim (am macOS) ffren ifuyla n tfelwiyin (am .rockbox) s tɣawla, tzemreḍ ad tferneḍ KRA n uḍris neɣ aẓar n tfelwit deg umyurar-ik. Ad ak-naf neɣ ad d-nesnulfu aḍris .rockbox s wudem awurman.

donate_family_appeal_nursery: Ryan d umcic-is ttheyyin i mmi-tsen. Ma yella allal-agi yella-d d anfay, tukci n tɣawsiwin n uxeddim d twacult-nneɣ i d-yettnernin ad tɛiwen ugar n wayen tessneḍ.

donate_support_appeal_archive_forever: Firmware yettwakkes mi ara ttwaqqnen yimsuddsen. Tiwsiwin ḥerzent tifelwiyin i d-isellken amyurar-ik deg usmel.
donate_support_appeal_bandwidth: Archive n useɣzan ameẓyan yettmuddu terabytes yal aggur. Tiwsiwin ttxellisent i bandwidth i t-id-yettawin.
donate_support_appeal_behind_the_scenes: Ulac taṛmist deffir waya, ala yiwen n usnefli, yiwen n usmel n uxeddim d usebter n tmeɣra. Kulci yettkemmil s tɣawsiwin n uxeddim.
donate_support_appeal_coffee_math: Yiwet n lqahwa tettḍeggiɛ qrib bandwidth n yiwen n usnulfu. Yeṭṭef asenfar i d-iteddun deg ufus.
donate_support_appeal_evenings: Yal aẓawan dagi yettwabna deg tmeddit d wass n tgara n ddurt. Tajmilt tamecṭuḥt tessenz ugar n wakud-nni.
donate_support_appeal_independent: Ulac ads, ulac aḍfar d ulac tier yettwaxelṣen. Azarug yettwasfaydi s tedrimt n yimdanen ay d-iɛawnen waya.
donate_support_appeal_kindness: Ma yella ayagi ixeddem-ak, ssiwḍet lxir-nni. Yettaǧǧa asenfar d ilelli i win ara d-yasen sdat-s.
donate_support_appeal_long_nights: Bugs ttwaṣeggmen imi kra yeqqim d amudel-ik deg lbanka. Tajmilt tettkemmil aya.
donate_support_appeal_monthly_costs: Idrimen n uxeddim ttasen-d azal n 200 n yidularen deg wayyur. Ayen akk ara t-ternuḍ yettqerrib ɣer lḥebs.
donate_support_appeal_next_feature: Allalen, iḍrisen d tmeẓriwt llan akk d ilelliyen. A tip funds n tfekka i d-iteddun.
donate_support_appeal_no_subscription: Ulac asenqed, ulac azemz n tgara, d asebter kan am wa. Efk-d kan ma yella iɛawen.
donate_support_appeal_one_person: Yiwen n umdan yettarra-d timsal, yettaru iḍrisen yerna yettxelliṣ-d tifatuṛin. Tiwsiwin ttgent aya d ayen ara yeqqimen.
donate_support_appeal_rescue: Kra seg yimariren ay yettɛawan waya ttwarun-d d akken ttwaqerḍen. Tajmilt tettaǧǧa lxedma n usellek ad teddu.
donate_support_appeal_servers: Iqeddacen, aḥezzeb d yiḥricen ttwaxelṣen seg lǧib. A lqahwa teṭṭef iḍebsiyen deg usmel i bab-is i d-iteddun.
donate_support_appeal_small_change: Kra n yidinaren tteddun abrid ɣezzifen dagi : ttḍeggiren lbaḍna i tmiḍiyin n tmeẓdiyin.
donate_support_appeal_testbench: Tiwsiwin sɣent-d imyurar n tesleḍt d yiferdisen yettwasqedcen i uḍfar n yal aẓawan uqbel ad t-id-yesfeḍ yiwen.
